description.value: The study investigated grey matter atrophy correlates of inhibitory dysfunction in Parkinson's disease versus behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia using region-of-interest voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: In this study, we investigated whether grey matter atrophy in fronto-striatal brain regions contributes to inhibitory dysfunction – a key feature of impulsive behaviour – in PD.

value: Our predictions were that PD patients would show inhibitory dysfunction in comparison to controls on verbal and non-verbal measures, however, that these deficits would be milder than in bvFTD.
We further predicted that striatal atrophy would correlate with the disinhibition measures in PD, while bvFTD would show more prefrontal atrophy correlates for failure to inhibit.
